extras: Uses private Obsidian graph internals, so Obsidian updates may require a plugin update.
intentEvidence: Give your Obsidian graph more room to spread sideways.
problem: The native Obsidian graph view can become too dense or cramped, limiting the visual spread of nodes.
summary: Graph Squeeze modifies the native Obsidian graph view by applying invisible horizontal force areas that push nodes inward, allowing the graph to spread wider.
